fields.description: SAMANA Ocean Bay has two apartment towers on Dubai Islands, with one- to four-bedroom homes and private pools. Selected layouts add storage, laundry or maid’s rooms, separate from the bedroom count.

research.paymentNote: Official sheet and current website: 20% booking + 10% in months 12, 18 and 24 + 25 post-handover monthly payments of 2% = 100%. Property Finder instead lists 60/40. Confirm the applicable unit contract.
